gold.pkMethod: Reported prices are the rates issued by the All Pakistan Sarafa Gems and Jewellers Association (APSGJA), as carried by the Associated Press of Pakistan. We check each one against the international price and reject any that differ by more than 5%. 21K and 18K prices are calculated from the 24K rate by purity (karat ÷ 24), the way Sarafa markets quote them.
gold.otherMethod: No trade body in {country} publishes a free daily feed we may reuse, so these prices are estimates: international spot price × exchange rate × purity{premium}. Jewellery shops add making charges and taxes.

PK.q: What is the gold rate in Pakistan today?
PK.a: The table at the top shows today's 24K, 22K, 21K and 18K prices per tola, per 10 grams and per gram, with the time of the last update.

PK.q: How many grams are in one tola?
PK.a: One tola is 11.6638 grams. Ten grams are about 0.857 tola.

PK.q: Why is the price in my city the same?
PK.a: The All Pakistan Sarafa Gems and Jewellers Association sets one rate for the whole country. Jewellers then add making charges, which differ between shops and designs.

PK.q: Why do 22K and 21K cost less than 24K?
PK.a: Purity. 24K is close to pure gold; 22K is 22 parts gold out of 24 (91.7%), 21K is 87.5% and 18K is 75%. Prices are scaled by that share.
An estimated price is calculated from the international gold price, the dollar rate and purity, used when the association has not published a figure yet that day.

other.q: How is the gold price in {country} calculated?
other.a: We take the international spot price per troy ounce, convert it to {currency} at the day's reference exchange rate and scale it by weight and purity. It is labelled 'estimated'.

other.q: Why is the price in a shop higher?
other.a: Shops add making charges and, where it applies, VAT or sales tax. These vary by shop and design and are not included.

other.q: What is the difference between 24K, 22K and 18K?
other.a: 24K is close to pure gold. 22K is 91.7% gold, 21K is 87.5% and 18K is 75%; the price scales with the gold content.

premiumNotes.IN: the import levy on gold: 5% basic customs duty plus 1% AIDC, Union Budget 2024-25; 3% GST is charged on top at purchase

faq.a: The table shows today's silver price per tola and per 10 grams, as reported by the Sarafa association or estimated from the international price when no report is available yet.

faq.q: Is the silver rate the same in every city?
faq.a: Yes. The association publishes one rate for Pakistan; shops add making charges for jewellery.

faq.a: A troy ounce is 31.1035 grams, the standard unit for precious metal prices worldwide.

faq.q: Why do I see a different price at a dealer?
faq.a: Dealers sell above the international spot price to cover fabrication, delivery and margin, and buy back below it.

currency.openNote: Open market rates are what exchange companies buy and sell cash at. Interbank rates are what banks trade at, published by the State Bank of Pakistan.
currency.noPkr: Open market and interbank rates are published for the rupee only. The reference rate below applies.

faq.q: What is the difference between the open market and interbank rate?
faq.a: The interbank rate is the rate banks trade at with each other, published daily by the State Bank of Pakistan. The open market rate is what exchange companies charge for cash, usually a little higher.

faq.q: What do buying and selling mean?
faq.a: Buying is the rate the exchange company pays you for foreign currency. Selling is what you pay to buy foreign currency from them.
Open market rates several times each business day, interbank rates once a day after the State Bank publishes them, reference rates daily.
